artists.source_line: Welcome to the 8th edition of #BeyondKizomba, the cultural immersion program in Angola that is designed by Rui Djassi Morácen, the founder of the University of Kizomba initiative, in partnership with – and backed by the logistics support of – Kunanga Life, a legally registered Angolan cultural tourism agency. In this edition, we will have, amongst a vast array of exciting events, a special party dedicated to honor the great work that #Back2Basic has been doing in promoting kizomba (and Angolan culture at large) in Europe consistently for so many years.

features.rationale: The Full package list states that hotel accommodation for 12 days and 11 nights is included.

features.quote: Three (3) meals a day (breakfast, lunch, dinner);
features.rationale: The package includes three meals a day.
Airport pick-up and drop-off transfers are included in the package.

features.quote: ALL group dance classes (incl. kizomba, semba, etc)
features.rationale: Group dance classes are part of the package, so dance classes are part of the event.

features.quote: private classes are booked and paid individually out of pocket
features.rationale: The text states that private classes can be booked and paid for separately.
Music concerts are listed among the included group nightlife activities.
